| 1 each | mixed | `ki-2026-07-06-synthetics-signin-transient-step-duration-spike` (+1), `ki-2026-07-07-gateway-4xx-spike-monitor-noise` (+0), `ki-2026-07-07-notifications-p95-latency-monitor-noise` (-8, was 9), `ki-2026-07-02-tables-fields-fieldtablenameref-null-linked-fields` (+1), `ki-2026-07-09-tables-fields-getfieldnames-duplicate-key-shippingaddress` (+0) | mixed |

*New this week:* none — no KB entry has `first_seen` inside this window.

*Aging:* 12 of 13 entries active this week have `fix_status` effectively unchanged ≥30d (proxy: no `prior_fix_status` recorded + age since `first_seen` — the KB schema has no dedicated status-change timestamp, so true unchanged-duration may be shorter than shown). Oldest: `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring`, still `investigating` ~78d (261 occurrences all-time). Also stale: `ki-2026-07-06-synthetics-signin-transient-step-duration-spike` (~74d, `needs-human`), `ki-2026-07-02-tables-fields-fieldtablenameref-null-linked-fields` (~73d, `needs-human`), `ki-2026-07-03-eda-consumer-amqp-stopped-publishing` (~51d, `escalated-for-review`). The one exception is `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`, which has a genuine recorded status change to `chronic-residual-post-rollback-2026-06-05` — but that's itself ~66d old now.

*Concentration:* top 3 (`ki-...gateway-microservices-timeout`, `ki-...crm-amqp...flap`, `ki-...grid-dropdown...nodata`) = 41 of 62 occurrences (66%) — essentially matches Method's standing ~66% all-time top-3 figure; unchanged in shape from last week.

*Suppression ratio:* known-issue-recurrence — 66/117 (56%) suppressed inside the 24h window, 51 posted (window-expiry or 10th-occurrence resurface, all logged `message_type=known-issue`; no `known-issue-recurrence` spelling appeared this window). needs-human — 23/27 (85%) held to `actionable.md` (daily-cap-deferred or below escalation threshold), 4 posted.

One thing worth doing next week: `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring` has sat at `investigating` for ~78 days across 261 occurrences — no other entry this active has gone this long without a status decision.

🚨 *new alert — needs human*  (score: 5)
Channel: alert-system (degraded-mode DD-scan-diff proxy — no Slack MCP this session)  •  bug-type guess: unknown (3rd-party integration gap, not yet attributable to Method code)  •  alerts in group: 1
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Transactions` (`@transactions` / `#team-transactions`)

Symptoms:
  - DD monitor 295882894 "[Rainforest] Webhook Traffic Outage (Business Hours)" fired No Data at 13:01:01Z — no inbound Rainforest webhook events received by runtime-core-api in the last 60 minutes.
  - Last real inbound webhook hit was 11:18:00Z (~1h51m silent as of scan time 13:09:07Z), still firing.
  - Outbound Method→Rainforest calls continued until 12:54:00Z — well after inbound went dark, matching the established Rainforest-side-only shape (not the 2026-08-03 dual-direction-silence variant).

Trace IDs: n/a (metric/monitor-sourced, not a single request trace)
Likely cause: Consistent with Rainforest not delivering webhooks (mechanism matches the 07-22/07-24/07-27 pattern), but NOT auto-classified as the known false-alarm because the existing KB entry's precedence_note requires confirmed short + self-resolving silence, and this fire was still active (unresolved) at scan time.
Suggested next action: monitor for self-resolution next cycle; if it recurs as a clean short/self-resolving gap, no action needed (matches known FA pattern). If duration extends materially past ~2h or outbound traffic also goes silent, escalate — may indicate a Rainforest-side outage or (per the 08-03 precedent) an undetected Method-side regression in the integration path.

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-29-methodsession-getaccountbysubdomain-nre`
This is occurrence #31 (last_notified_at was 2026-08-07T13:12:48Z — ~3d0h4m ago, 24h suppression window had expired).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`)
Playbook: 1) Confirm synthetic-only: ES aggregate message:'JWT Retrieval Failed' by fields.UserAgent.keyword -- if 100% WindowsPowerShell and 0 real browsers, there is no customer impact; deprioritize. 2) Confirm the NRE: search the same docs for exceptions[].StackTraceString containing GetAccountBySubdomain in Com.Method.ServiceContract/Services/Account/MethodSessionService.cs. 3) Two independent fixes, pick per owner: (a) CODE -- add a null guard in MethodSessionService.GetAccountBySubdomain() so a missing/unknown subdomain returns 400/empty-session instead of dereferencing null (source is TFS-built Com.Method.ServiceContract, NOT in the GitHub clones -- route to the platform-ui/MethodUI backend owner); (b) MONITORING -- fix the Centreon synthetic check to send a valid account subdomain / Host header, or point it at a health endpoint that doesn't require an account, which silences both the false-CRITICAL Centreon alerts and the Datadog Watchdog 236570583 'New issue to review' noise. 4) Establish WHY it started at ~12:51Z (check Centreon check-config change history around that time). 5) Until fixed, #alert-system will keep getting intermittent Centreon CRITICALs + Watchdog 236570583 fires for this pattern -- treat as monitoring noise, not a customer outage.
